verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop agent-orchestration app, but the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking controls. The local-first claim that code never leaves the machine concerns code data, not telemetry, so it is an adjacent claim and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
